Intrinsically <barrier/>Anti-Barrier. 

Deals 100% increased damage against <link Champions [#CombatantClassifications] /> at all times.

Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a charge of 'Targeting Data'. Maximum of 4 charges.

Hold [Reload] to convert each fully charged stack of Targeting Data into a precision sniper round. Sniper rounds fire at 72RPM, have perfect accuracy (even from the hip), and deal <pve 1671.6 /> <pvp [474] /> precision damage.

Hits with sniper rounds trigger a <pve 280 /> <pvp [20] /> damage Kinetic Shockwave that applies Exhaust in a 6? meter radius.
